We should call the functions accordingly. The user wants both masses and diameters. So we need to call getWeight twice (for Neutron and Proton) and getDiameter twice. Or we could combine? We should produce a single response with the results. We'll call the functions sequentially. We'll first call getWeight for Neutron, then getWeight for Proton, then getDiameter for Neutron, then getDiameter for Proton. Then combine results.
